outcome: Risk of emergency cesarean section after induction of labor
cohort: Women with singleton term pregnancies undergoing induction of labor with a Bishop score of 6 or less
finding: Maternal height, nulliparity, closed cervix, fetal station -3 above ischial spine, firm or medium cervical consistency, cervical length 3 cm or longer, and posterior cervix are significantly associated with an increased risk of emergency cesarean section after induction of labor.
